replacements.Puertas lógicas: del pensamiento a los c: Logic gates: from thought to circuits
Boole showed that logic is algebra. Shannon showed that this algebra can be implemented with electrical switches. With just three basic gates, any digital circuit can be built.
replacements.La salida es 1 solo cuando <em>todas</em: The output is 1 only when all inputs are 1. The switch opens only if two people press at the same time.
replacements.Uso real: selector de condición — la CPU: Real use: condition selector — the CPU activates an operation only when two conditions are true at the same time.
replacements.La salida es 1 cuando <em>al menos una</: The output is 1 when at least one input is 1. The switch opens if either person presses.
replacements.Uso real: detección de errores — una ala: Real use: error detection — an alarm activates if any sensor detects a problem.
replacements.Una sola entrada: invierte su valor. 0 s: A single input: it inverts its value. 0 becomes 1, and 1 becomes 0. This is logical negation.
replacements.Uso real: complemento — NAND = AND + NOT: Real use: complement — NAND = AND + NOT, a building block of modern chips because of its silicon efficiency.
replacements.Con solo puertas NAND (AND seguido de NO: With NAND gates alone (AND followed by NOT), any digital circuit can be built. Modern chips contain millions of NAND-equivalent gate structures.
replacements.A + B produce un bit de <strong>suma (S): A + B produces one sum bit (S) and one carry bit (C). Two gates, four possible input combinations.
replacements.Encadenando sumadores de 1 bit se suman: Chaining 1-bit adders lets us add numbers of any practical width. A CPU contains billions of logic gates built from transistor networks.
